title: These bags are ok, not great
text:
These bags are ok, not great. These are good for shopping trips for small items. The bags aren't very big, but they will do the job. Since they come in a set of 12, I'm sure you could manage a small shopping trip.

What I don't like about them is the fact they wrinkle so badly after washing and drying. The handles especially wrinkle and you can't smooth them out. It would have to be ironed.
